targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-732 policy-learning discriminator (diagnostic, claim_ids=[], non_contributory -- promotes/demotes nothing). Self-routed H2_observation_interface_unlearnable (b1/b2 sub-floor, readiness met). Autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-732_2026-07-10 REJECTS the H2 verdict as UNCONFIRMED: the shared 200-episode / ~40k-step Monte-Carlo A2C budget was set for the B1-vs-B2 contrast, not for learnability; the H2 arm B2 (vanilla raw-obs) was the BEST arm (0.35) and foraged in 12/20 episodes on seed 42 (partial-learning signature, not an unlearnable interface); net reward was negative across all arms (contamination-dominated credit-assignment confound); and 732's readiness battery validates env-achievability (oracle 6.05) but has NO learner-adequacy gate -- so a sub-floor B2 conflates 'unlearnable observation' with 'under-powered learner' (direct analog of the V3-EXQ-642 precondition-unmet incident). 732 is UNDER-POWERED, resolving neither H1 nor H2. Routed to /queue-experiment for V3-EXQ-732a (supersedes 732): re-run the discriminator with an off-policy/minibatched learner (PPO/DQN) at 10-50x budget + stronger exploration + a learner-adequacy readiness gate, BEFORE any observation-encoding build. No substrate_queue write (recommended_substrate_queue_entry.action=none) -- the build target is exactly what the powered re-run decides. Brake-exempt (no claim tagged).

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.rationale: H2 (observation-encoding gap) is NOT confirmed. Queuing an observation-encoding substrate now would build on an unconfirmed ceiling (the V3-EXQ-642 failure mode). The build target -- action/policy substrate (H1) vs observation encoding (H2) -- is exactly what the re-powered discriminator V3-EXQ-732a decides.

re_derive_brake.reason_not_fired: claim_ids=[] (claim-keyed counter is 0); and the confirmed routing is a re-queue that explicitly REFUSES to declare a ceiling, so the brake's intent (do not build on an unconfirmed ceiling) is satisfied a fortiori. The 719a->724->732 chain is a healthy localization drill-down, not a same-claim re-derive loop.

learning_extracted: A 'sub-floor control' is only an 'unlearnable' verdict if the control was trained enough to succeed; 732's B2 was starved to ~200 Monte-Carlo updates and was still the best, partially-foraging arm (seed-42 12/20).
A discriminator's budget must be sized for the harder of its questions; 732's was sized for the equal-starvation contrast, too small to answer the learnability question the H2 branch needs.

Readiness batteries need a learner-adequacy gate, not just env-achievability: oracle-clears-floor proves the ENV is solvable with privileged access, not that the learner extracts the solution from the observation at the given budget.
Monte-Carlo A2C at ~200 updates is the wrong control for a 'can it be learned at all' question; an off-policy/minibatched learner (PPO/DQN) with many updates per env-step is the fair control.

719a->724->732 is a healthy localization drill-down; but 732a is the third diagnostic routing to re-queue -- if a properly-powered 732a still fails to resolve H1 vs H2, that recurrence is the signal (is the competence question well-posed on this env), not another power bump.

requeue_spec.label_rule: alphabetic suffix (same scientific question, implementation power-fix)
changes: Replace end-of-episode Monte-Carlo A2C (~200 updates) with PPO or DQN doing minibatched updates per rollout, at a 10-50x larger budget known to solve comparable gridworld foraging; apply the SAME learner+budget to BOTH B1 and B2 so the representation-front-end contrast stays powered.
Stronger exploration than entropy_beta 0.01 (raise entropy and/or add a count-based/novelty bonus for the sparse pre-first-resource phase).
Normalize/rescale returns so foraging is not drowned by contamination penalties (net-negative reward across all 732 arms); keep P2 mean_resources_per_episode as the load-bearing DV.

ADD a learner-adequacy readiness gate: the vanilla control must clear foraging (>= X% of oracle) on a plain sanity env within budget before any sub-floor is read as an H2 verdict; failure => substrate_not_ready_requeue (learner too weak), NOT an H2 verdict.

interpretation_grid.powered_b2_clears: observation IS learnable -> H1 (build action/policy substrate under f_dominance_conversion_ceiling, informed by MECH-455 competence-based IM); B1-vs-B2 delta then distinguishes H1 vs deeper-H1 (representation helps/hurts).
interpretation_grid.powered_b2_subfloor_with_learner_adequac: H2 CONFIRMED -> THEN route /implement-substrate on the observation encoding.
